Aadhaar authentication voluntary for Delhi citizen services
 Published - November 17, 2026 05:30 am IST 
 The Hindu Bureau Subscribe to The Hindu @ Just ₹1* Subscribe to The Hindu @ Just $4.99 *Offer only for new subscribers 
 PUNE, 20/05/2025: (Spotlight on Aadhar Card by Purnima Sah) Subhala Pawar displays her documents who struggle with basic government schemes and facilities due to absence or error in Aadhar card Photo: EMMANUAL YOGINI/ The Hindu
 | Photo Credit: EMMANUAL YOGINI
 A notification issued by the Delhi government’s Information Technology Department on November 12 has made Aadhaar authentication voluntary for residents accessing citizen services. No service will be denied to anyone who refuses or is unable to undergo Aadhaar authentication, it said.
 Advertisement Advertisement The notification states: “Aadhaar authentication is on voluntary basis. The said Department shall inform to the Aadhaar number holder of alternate and viable means of identification and shall not deny any service to the Aadhaar number holder for refusing to, or being unable to, undergo Aadhaar authentication.”
 The department is now required to inform Aadhaar number holders about alternative and viable means of identification and ensure that no service is denied on account of their refusal or inability to complete authentication.
 The notification was issued under Rule 5 of the Aadhaar Authentication for Good Governance (Social Welfare, Innovation, Knowledge) Rules, 2020, read with provisions of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016.

 It said Aadhaar authentication, which enables individuals to access subsidies, benefits and services conveniently, reduces the need for multiple documents, simplifies processes and promotes transparency and efficiency. Its use for specified purposes, including improving access to services, promoting ease of living and preventing misuse of social welfare benefits, will remain voluntary.
 Aadhaar authentication will also remain voluntary for the Unified Citizen Data Platform (UCDP), the notification said.
